image.subject: KLM第107號藍陶小屋與De Kleine Schorre酒莊建築。

zh.title: 荷蘭皇家航空迎107週年　第107號藍陶小屋以荷蘭酒莊為原型
zh.summary: KLM於10月7日迎來107週年，揭曉以澤蘭省De Kleine Schorre酒莊為原型的第107號藍陶小屋，延續自1952年開始的機上贈禮與收藏傳統。
body: 荷蘭皇家航空（KLM）於2026年10月7日迎來成立107週年，並依循年度傳統，揭曉第107號台夫特藍陶小屋。今年選中的建築為荷蘭澤蘭省德賴斯霍爾村的De Kleine Schorre酒莊，將這家長年供應機上葡萄酒的合作夥伴納入收藏系列。
KLM成立於1919年10月7日，是全球仍以創立時名稱營運、歷史最悠久的航空公司。藍陶小屋則始於1952年，當時提供給頭等艙旅客，屋內最初盛裝利口酒，後來改為荷蘭傳統杜松子酒，如今贈送對象為洲際航班的商務艙旅客。
這項傳統的起源與當時航空業對旅客贈禮的限制有關。根據世界航空歷史協會的介紹，KLM將酒裝進荷蘭運河屋造型的陶瓷容器，以機上提供的「最後一杯酒」處理，藉此符合贈禮限制。旅客喝完後仍可保留小屋，使原本的酒瓶逐漸成為兼具荷蘭建築特色與航空紀念意義的收藏品。
自1994年成立75週年起，KLM讓小屋系列編號與公司年齡相對應，並固定於每年10月7日推出新款。今年的De Kleine Schorre酒莊成立於2001年，自2006年起供應KLM洲際商務艙葡萄酒；第107號小屋也是系列中第三座來自澤蘭省的建築。

en.title: KLM Marks 107th Anniversary With Delft Blue House Modeled on Dutch Winery
en.summary: KLM unveiled its 107th Delft Blue miniature house on October 7, honoring De Kleine Schorre winery in Zeeland and continuing an onboard tradition that began in 1952.
body: KLM Royal Dutch Airlines marked its 107th anniversary on October 7, 2026, by unveiling Delft Blue miniature house No. 107 in keeping with its annual tradition. This year's miniature is modeled on De Kleine Schorre winery in Dreischor, in the Dutch province of Zeeland, adding a long-standing supplier of onboard wines to the collection.

Founded on October 7, 1919, KLM is the world's oldest airline still operating under its original name. The Delft Blue house tradition began in 1952, when the miniatures were presented to First Class passengers. Initially filled with liqueur and later with Dutch genever, they are now given to Business Class passengers on intercontinental flights.

The tradition originated in restrictions on passenger gifts in the airline industry at the time. According to the World Airline Historical Society, KLM served alcohol in ceramic containers shaped like Dutch canal houses as a final onboard drink, allowing it to comply with those restrictions. Passengers could keep the houses after drinking the contents, and the bottles gradually became collectibles combining Dutch architectural character with aviation memorabilia.

Since its 75th anniversary in 1994, KLM has aligned the number of houses in the series with the airline's age and introduced a new miniature each October 7. De Kleine Schorre was established in 2001 and has supplied wine for KLM's intercontinental Business Class since 2006. House No. 107 is also the collection's third building from Zeeland.
